part.text: The original code popped the woken waiter out of `_wait_queue` and called `event.set()` in `_notify_next_waiter`, but only added that waiter to `_borrowers` later — after `await event.wait()` resumed — so for that interval the freed token existed in neither the wait queue nor the borrower set. The `acquire_nowait` guard (`if self._wait_queue or len(self._borrowers) >= self._total_tokens`) therefore saw an apparently empty limiter and admitted a second borrower for a single token.
